Delhi Sanitation Worker Killed; Accused Arrested Amid Protests

A sanitation worker, identified as Anil, was stabbed to death in Delhi's Kalyanpuri. The accused, who was reportedly angry over his wife's calls, has been arrested. Following the killing, sanitation workers and drivers began protesting, halting auto-tipper services across Delhi. The victim's family has refused to claim the body until their demands, including Rs 1 crore compensation, are met. An AAP MLA was reportedly "picked up" by police while protesting over the incident.
